name: Ledger
subtitle: Ledger business simulation builds
description: Unsigned builds of the Ledger business simulation. AltStore signs them with your own Apple ID. The list is filled in by the IPA workflow after each successful build.

# What's new
- Balance: ads now stack on your name and show payback; second-store readiness; known brands resist rivals; skilled play out-earns idle play
- Accounting: balance sheet and cash flow; choose your accountant (Atlas, new company, conversion); people cost and pay day panels
- Inbox: "Handled by" and a Handled tab; messages open the right app; research reports open as documents
- Group: "Who runs what" table; own staff on a board; interview chips for manager candidates
- Goals link to where they are done; promises can be given more time
- Operations: repair at your own garage, add retail catalogue items, analyst and ranking in Market
- News links to the company; achievements show streaks; reports show more figures
- Hiring: mobile and remote roles no longer need a desk; checklist always completable; picker shows affordable trades

# Missing / coming next
- Wider skilled-vs-idle gap; screen-tour fixes

# What's new
- Remove people from a board (vote if you hold 50% or less; notice paid to outside directors)
- Portraits for managers, executives, board members; Inbox shows faces
- Home companies list is its own scrollable box
- Chain manager appoints regional managers; regional managers hire each store's manager; owner can approve or decline
- Open posts: search and hire from the Management tab, shows who hires and with what authority
- Market no longer sends "you bought" notices for cars a hired buyer bought

# Missing / coming next
- Own-delivery fee, typed prices per trade, chain/franchise steps, more photos
- Not yet tested on device: expect rough edges

# What's new
- Market: no more "you bought" notices for cars a hired buyer or manager bought; one quiet weekly note instead
- Profit today counts what you did between days (e.g. a new store in a chain)
- Popups: one overlay host and one text rule set

# Missing / coming next
- Board removal, manager pictures, scrollable companies box, chain/regional manager hiring in progress
- Own-delivery fee, typed prices per trade, chain/franchise steps, more photos

- Profit today now counts what you did since the last day, e.g. opening a new store in a chain
- Car dealership: stock budget in the start-up plan, no stockless day trade
- Popups: one overlay host and one text rule set; tall popups step back inside

# What's new
- Real products: items now have cost, stock, supplier and a live profit/loss price slider (item list like Team)
- Retail, food and drink, rentals and appointment trades sell real items (bakery recipes, rental units, treatments...)
- New-car dealership with brand contracts; dealer warranty, car loans and insurance commission
- Used car dealer: cars come only from the Marketplace, repairs by your own garage, lot spaces, stuck cars
- New trades: travel agency, insurance broker, finance broker

# Missing / coming next
- Used car list, car dealer screens and dealer add-on screens are being wired into the app
- Remaining trades (professional services, projects, venues, transport, finance) still sell generic items
- Not yet tested on device: expect rough edges

# What's new
- New start: country, trade, name; your business opens on day 1 with money for the first weeks and no loan; bills wait a day instead of overdrawing; the ambition appears after your first profitable month
- Skip to opening: pass the waiting days of a new company in one go
- More new-item markers (Reviews, Goals, Trophies, Bank loans, Applications, Competitors), at most eight per screen
- No false unlock announcements at the start of a game; the Custom tab falls back to Pick tab
- Week, month and year reports: short reveal with one story line; profit counts up in the daily report
- Events: fewer bad events early, more good ones, every event has a choice; first four weeks are quiet
- First-year ladder (10 goals) with rewards; owner hours capped before week 13; no supplier cutoff or bankruptcy in the first year
- New start: three steps (country, trade, name), company open on day 1; import/export moved to Settings › Saves
- Play: Next day is one day; Play to end of week from week 2; Inbox shows Needs you and All; a blocking event makes Play wait
- Reminders: three gentle notifications at most (20 h, 2 days, 7 days), off in Settings; play streak flame from 3 days
- Own staff
